reference_sql:
SELECT category_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS web_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS store_revenue_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY category_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) >= 0.6 * SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END)
alternatives: SELECT category_name, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur END) AS web_revenue_eur, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur END) AS store_revenue_eur FROM sales GROUP BY category_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur END) >= 0.6 * SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur END)

SELECT category_name, SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS web_revenue_eur, SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') AS store_revenue_eur FROM sales GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') >= 0.6 * SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store')
